comments.author: MusicManiac
comments.body_html: Additionally, would be nice to have “max durability drain” where we can set up how much max durability is drained per each HP repaired, so, for example, for each HP repaired we could set up that it drains 0.1 (or any other number) max durability. Because as of now, you never need additional armors/rigs besides couple of spare kits, since you end up with full armor anyway. If we’d have such option it’d make use of spare rigs since eventually your max durability will get slashed.
